=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:423 vs 459-466 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: validate_contract accepts legacy standalone-only vars in inline placeholders, but _render_inline_placeholders leaves them unresolved.
  WHY: This validation/rendering mismatch can ship raw {{...}} text into rendered prompts for future templates that use a legacy var inline.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:27, 480-488 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Inline placeholders for legacy block-only vars are explicitly preserved as literal {{VAR}} text, so inline uses of WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION, SEMBLE_PREFETCH, or SERENA_TOOL_HINTS stay unresolved.
  WHY: This leaves a behavioral inconsistency versus the general renderer goal and can emit literal placeholders to the LLM.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:104-122 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Contract discovery walks overlapping candidate roots without a clear preference boundary, so an unexpected overlay directory can supply the contract.
  WHY: In repos with both .codex-workflow-src and local overrides, the wrong or stale contract may load silently.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:200-280 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The minimal YAML parser rejects indented blocks and rich scalars, so valid contracts can fail to load when PyYAML is unavailable.
  WHY: A consumer without PyYAML may get parse errors on contracts the implementation expects to accept.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:52-70 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The shim is still a backward-compatibility risk because it hard-codes trusted backends and no longer preserves the earlier temp-file/trap behavior.
  WHY: Callers expecting prior shell-wrapper behavior may see output/side-effect differences while the removal preflight is not yet satisfiable.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
